[[File:Luke_poncho2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Luke Skywalker wore a poncho in the harsh deserts of Tatooine.]]
A '''poncho''' was an article of clothing worn by [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] used for blending in with the wearer's environment or for style. Individuals that were known to have worn a poncho included [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]; [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]; Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]; [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]; and the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The [[camouflage poncho]] was a type of poncho.
